entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE in response to identity request during identification procedure.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE registration with the network.

entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: Procedure where network requests identity information from UE.

entities.name: Requested identity not available
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot provide requested identity due to missing USIM or other reasons.

entities.name: Encode identity type as No identity
entities.description: UE behavior when requested identity is unavailable - encodes identity type as 'No identity' in IDENTITY RESPONSE.

entities.name: Re-initiate registration procedure
entities.description: UE behavior to restart registration procedure after IDENTITY RESPONSE transmission failure.

relations.description: IDENTITY RESPONSE message is part of the identification procedure.
Identification procedure can be triggered during registration procedure.
When requested identity is unavailable, UE encodes identity type as 'No identity'.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message behavior is guarded by identity availability condition.
Transmission failure of IDENTITY RESPONSE leads to re-initiation of registration procedure.
